tools.name: ricursor_action_check
tools.description: Metadata-only decision for a JS/TS write or delete. Returns allow or block (with reasons to fix) plus a one-use receipt. Never send source.

tools.name: ricursor_action_consume
tools.description: Atomically consumes a receipt immediately before the broker executes. Fails if anything changed.

tools.name: ricursor_action_group_check
tools.description: Metadata-only decision for up to 20 related JS/TS writes/deletes judged on their combined end state (moves, renames).

tools.name: ricursor_action_group_consume
tools.description: All-or-nothing consumption before the broker writes the group.

tools.name: ricursor_correct
tools.description: After Ricursor blocks a check, save the one-sentence lesson so every agent on this project gets it. Only accepted for your own blocked action from the last 24 hours.

tools.name: ricursor_ledger
tools.description: Read scoped metadata and rule versions before switching models. Observe only.

tools.name: ricursor_handoff
tools.description: Save structured task IDs and versioned rule decisions; never include prompts or source.

tools.name: ricursor_snapshot
tools.description: Sync locally extracted JS/TS structural metadata only; never transmit source.

tools.name: ricursor_check
tools.description: Stop on block or errors. Checks tracked versions, exports and accepted import boundaries; never writes code.

tools.name: ricursor_workspaces
tools.description: The workspace this key can reach.

tools.name: ricursor_context
tools.description: The verified corrections and recent file changes an agent must respect before it writes code.

tools.name: ricursor_report
tools.description: Record what an agent spent (usage) and what it changed (state).
